text:
Nora V: Hi all went to a client kickoff in Lisbon last week. A couple of weird things: (1) corporate card auto-blocked mid-trip so I paid an upgrade to Premium Economy for medical reasons on my personal card, (2) I lost the boarding pass on the outbound but have the e-ticket PDF, (3) one dinner included alcohol and I want to confirm policy treatment, and (4) final invoice from our travel agency lists fees as separate line items (service fee + VAT). What's the preferred way to submit?

Ethan (People Ops): Thanks for flagging, Nora. High-level: submit itemized receipts and the travel agency invoice, attach a short note explaining the card block, and include manager approval for the premium economy upgrade. For the boarding pass, the e-ticket PDF is fine as proof; attach any gate/seat emails if you have them.

Nora V: For the upgrade medical note do I need to upload a doctor's note? It's a non-sensitive note (back pain), I prefer not to scan medical paperwork.

Finance Ops Bot: @Nora V we don't require full medical records. For medically necessary upgrades, upload a short attestation stating the reason and manager approval. If the amount exceeds $750, we may request corroboration from People Ops (email confirmation is OK). Use category "Travel - Upgrade (medical)" in the form.

Nora V: OK. Here's the attestation template I'll use:

```
Upgrade attestation
Employee: Nora V
Date: 2026-09-14
Upgrade: Premium Economy (paid on personal card)
Amount: $420.00
Reason: Short-term back strain; upgrade needed for medical comfort. Manager approver: Marcos L
```

Marcos L: I approve this upgrade. I saw the back pain note and we discussed prior to travel. Marcos L (manager).

Nora V: About the dinner: the meal receipt includes two bottles of wine. Our policy says alcohol is reimbursable up to moderate amounts; do I need to separate the line items?

Ethan (People Ops): For meals with alcohol, upload the itemized receipt. If alcohol appears as a separate line item we ask you to flag it in the form (Meals > Alcohol portion). Small amounts are reimbursable; large wine purchases or rare bottles may need justification as client entertainment. If you classified it as client entertainment (guest present), include client names and business purpose.

Nora V: It was client entertainment for two clients. Total meal was EUR 220, wine line is EUR 60. Sounds like I should tag it as Entertainment and include client names.

Finance Ops Bot: Correct. Use "Entertainment - Client" category and attach the client names + business purpose. Manager approval required for entertainment. Also note: entertainment does not reduce per-diem because per-diem is not used when itemized expenses are submitted.

Travel Desk Bot: FYI the agency invoice service fees are valid. Upload the agency invoice PDF; if VAT is listed separately, keep it. Finance will net any refundable VAT during reconciliation. If the agency charged in GBP but the supplier charged in EUR, keep original currency lines; system handles conversion.

Nora V: Lost boarding pass e-ticket only is that sufficient for missing baggage claims? I had a bag issue on return and they asked for pass.

Ethan (People Ops): E-ticket PDF + bag tag number (if available) plus carrier claim email is sufficient for reimbursement and loss claims. If carrier requests a boarding pass, ask them to accept the e-ticket QR/email. Upload screenshots of the carrier correspondence.

Nora V: One last: can I request Finance to pay the agency directly so the vendor shows up on company ledger? I have the invoice in the agency portal but payment deadline is this week.

Finance Ops Bot: We can attempt supplier payment but need Procurement sign-off if amount > $2k or new vendor. Request a vendor pay via the expense system by selecting "Company pay vendor" and attach the invoice and procurement approval. If faster, personal reimbursement is usually quicker.

Nora V: Thanks. I'll compile: e-ticket.pdf, agency_invoice.pdf, dinner_receipt_itemized.jpg, upgrade_attestation.txt (with Marcos approval), carrier_emails.pdf. Any naming rules?

Ethan (People Ops): Naming: YYYYMMDD_type_vendor_amount_currency (e.g., 20260914_upgrade_PremiumAir_420_USD; 20260912_Lisbon_dinner_220_EUR). For attestation files append _attest. For anything pending (like VAT refund) add _PENDING in the filename.

Marcos L: Approved. If Nora wants, I can add a manager comment in the expense system to speed review.

Nora V: Great Ill submit tonight and tag @Ethan for a quick pre-check. Appreciate the help.

Finance Ops Bot: Reminder: receipts older than 60 days need an exception flag. Also, if you have multi-currency items we'll use the official daily rate at submission.

Ethan (People Ops): Thanks everyone. @Nora V we'll fast-track this one given the medical reason.
